QF.id: IV Introduction to Interest Rate Derivatives_17

question.text: The definition of 'Derivatives' was included in the Securities Laws through:

explanation.text: The Logic: The Securities Laws (Second Amendment) Act, 1999 included derivatives within the definition of "securities" under the Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956. The Trap: The SEBI Act, 1992 created SEBI but did not insert the derivatives definition into SC(R)A; that came specifically through the 1999 amendment. Note: The workbook ties the inclusion of derivatives in the SC(R)A "securities" definition to the 1999 amendment.
